凌晨三点，手机屏幕的冷光打在肖恩脸上，映出一双布满红血丝的眼睛。
“策划，你睡了吗？我睡不着。”
肖恩手指在屏幕上飞快敲击。
他在给steam平台上的一款黄油写差评。
“这游戏立绘顶满，建模社保，剧情却烂得像是在化粪池里发酵过三天。”
“作为一款标准的黄油，它的核心卖点本该是爽，但这狗策划不知是不是小时候缺爱，非要搞什么悲剧美学。”
游戏里的女性角色，尤其是那些拥有年上属性的配角，结局惨得千奇百怪。
不是被反派献祭，就是为了保护主角惨死，要么就是被贵族老爷们当成玩物，最后凄惨地死在阴暗的地牢里。
“全收集结局……全灭？”
看着屏幕上刚刚打通的真·隐藏结局，肖恩气得差点把手机捏爆。
“玩个黄油你给我发刀子？还是针对年上角色的刀子？”
对于肖恩来说，这简直是在挖他的祖坟。
他愤怒地敲下最后一行字：“如果能穿越进去，老子第一件事就是把那个叫肖恩的傻缺反派剁成肉泥，然后给所有年上oo一个家！”
发送。
就在指尖离开屏幕的瞬间，耳边传来一声尖锐的刹车声。
肖恩下意识抬头。
一辆失控的大货车像是从虚空中冲出来的钢铁巨兽，车头那两个刺眼的大灯瞬间吞没了他所有的视野。

痛感？
不存在的。
人的神经传输速度赶不上大货车的冲击力。
肖恩最后的念头居然是：妈的，手机没格式化。
……
……
“因边关战事吃紧。”
“怀特·霍尔登伯爵大人久久无法回来，现由伯爵大人的唯一长子，肖恩·霍尔登子爵掌管霍尔登家族的一切事务。”
肖恩猛地从床上坐起，大口喘息，冷汗顺着鬓角滑落，滴在锦缎织成的被面上。
他愣了一下。
目光下移，自己身上穿的不是那件并夕夕九块九包邮的聚酯纤维睡衣，而是一件做工考究，绣着金丝暗纹的丝绸睡衣。
视线再往外延伸。
巨大的落地窗，厚重的天鹅绒窗帘半掩，清晨的阳光透过缝隙洒在地板上，照亮了房间角落里那座造型古朴的魔法座钟。
滴答。滴答。
“这哪？”

At three o'clock in the morning, the cold light of the mobile phone screen hit Sean's face, reflecting a pair of red bloodshot eyes.
"Planner, are you asleep? I can't sleep."
Sean tapped his fingers rapidly on the screen.
He is writing a negative review for a butter on the steam platform.
"This game is full of visuals and models of social security, but the plot is as bad as if it had been fermented in a septic tank for three days."
"As a standard butter, its core selling point should be that it is delicious, but this dog planner wonders if he lacked love when he was a child, so he insists on some kind of tragic aesthetics."
The female characters in the game, especially those supporting characters with advanced attributes, have all kinds of tragic endings.
Either he was sacrificed by the villain, he died miserably to protect the protagonist, or he was used as a plaything by the nobles, and finally died miserably in a dark dungeon.
"The ending of all collection... total destruction?"
Looking at the true hidden ending that had just been completed on the screen, Sean was so angry that he almost exploded his phone.
"Just for fun, will you give me a knife? Or are you going to give me a knife for a senior character?"
For Sean, it was like digging up his ancestral grave.
He angrily typed out the last line: "If I could go back in time, the first thing I would do would be to chop that stupid villain named Sean into a pulp, and then give all the young people a home!"
Send.
The moment my fingertips left the screen, there was a sharp braking sound in my ears.
Sean looked up subconsciously.
A large, out-of-control truck looked like a giant steel beast rushing out of the void. The two dazzling headlights on the front of the truck instantly swallowed up all his vision.
痛感？
Doesn't exist.
Human nerve transmission speed cannot keep up with the impact of a large truck.
Sean's last thought was: Damn, the phone is not formatted.
…
…
"Due to the tense border war."
"Earl White Holden has not been able to come back for a long time. Now the Earl's only eldest son, Viscount Sean Holden, is in charge of all the affairs of the Holden family."
Sean suddenly sat up from the bed, gasping for breath, cold sweat sliding down his temples and dripping on the brocade quilt.
He was stunned for a moment.
Looking down, I saw that what I was wearing was not the polyester pajamas that came with free shipping for 9 yuan, but a silk pajamas with exquisite workmanship and embroidered with gold and dark patterns.
The line of sight extends further outward.
The huge floor-to-ceiling windows were half-covered by thick velvet curtains, and the morning sunlight shone through the gaps on the floor, illuminating the simple-looking magic clock in the corner of the room.
Tick ​​tock. Tick ​​tock.
"Where is this?"
